scripts.build:app: npm run build:core && ng build app --configuration=desa
scripts.build:app:prod: npm run build:core && ng build app --configuration=production
scripts.build:web: npm run build:core && ng build web-onboarding --configuration=desa
scripts.build:web:prod: npm run build:core && ng build web-onboarding --configuration=production
scripts.build:functions: cd functions && npm run build && cd ..
scripts.build:android: npm run build:app && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.build:apk: npm run build:app && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug && cd .. && if not exist "projects\web-onboarding\src\assets\apk" mkdir "projects\web-onboarding\src\assets\apk" && copy /Y "android\app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk" "projects\web-onboarding\src\assets\apk\adc-loslocos-desa.apk"
scripts.deploy:rules:desa: firebase use desa && firebase deploy --only firestore:rules

scripts.deploy:functions:desa: firebase use desa && npm run build:functions && firebase deploy --only functions

scripts.deploy:function:deleteUserCascade:desa: firebase use desa && npm run build:functions && firebase deploy --only functions:deleteUserCascade
scripts.deploy:function:deleteUserCascade:prod: firebase use prod && npm run build:functions && firebase deploy --only functions:deleteUserCascade
scripts.deploy:function:processEventAccess:desa: firebase use desa && npm run build:functions && firebase deploy --only functions:processEventAccess

scripts.deploy:monorepo:prod: npm run build:monorepo:prod && firebase use prod && firebase deploy
scripts.docs:generate: npx typedoc ./projects/shared-core/src/public-api.ts --tsconfig ./projects/shared-core/tsconfig.lib.json --skipErrorChecking --out ./docs/api-reference/shared-core --plugin typedoc-plugin-markdown --entryFileName index && npx typedoc ./functions/src/index.ts --tsconfig ./functions/tsconfig.json --skipErrorChecking --out ./docs/api-reference/functions --plugin typedoc-plugin-markdown --entryFileName index && npx typedoc --entryPoints ./src/**/*.ts --exclude ./**/*.spec.ts --tsconfig ./tsconfig.app.json --skipErrorChecking --out ./docs/api-reference/app-movil --plugin typedoc-plugin-markdown --entryFileName index && npx typedoc --entryPoints ./projects/web-onboarding/src/**/*.ts --exclude ./**/*.spec.ts --tsconfig ./projects/web-onboarding/tsconfig.app.json --skipErrorChecking --out ./docs/api-reference/web-onboarding --plugin typedoc-plugin-markdown --entryFileName index
